nom: medicube Collagen Milk Toning Wrapping Mask

avis.titre: So glowy!! Great texture, good peel
avis.texte: Only used it twice so far but really liking it. Was nervous about the peel - it worked! I left it on for about 25 minutes and it came off almost in one piece - it was actually satisfying ha, and didn't feel like crunchy or stiff. Avoid your eyebrows while you avoid your eyes (I had to use a wet towel to wipe there a bit). I felt sooooo glowy after taking this off, like I'd just gotten a facial. I feel good about it bringing longer lasting effects, but minimally it feels great after doing it. The container is gonna go fast for me though - maybe more of a weekly ritual than anything more frequent. Consider a brush to help lay it on, too. I saw some mentions of smell - it smells good to me, kinda fruity, not bad at all.

I really love the way this mask makes my skin look and feel. It has a slightly unpleasant chemical-like smell, but the scent is not overpowering. I prefer this to wearing the collagen sheet masks. You get the same effect in only 20 minutes and it peels off very easily. I would recommend trying it.

The mask had a rancid smell, I had to use vapo-rub under my nose to keep the smell at bay while I used the mask. It did give a glow; however, I wanted to clean my face again after because of the smell. I hope their other products aren't the same way.

I love the way my skin looks after I do this mask! You literally look like a glazed doughnut right after you peel it off. It only takes 20 minutes. I don't like those face masks that you have to wear as a sheet on your face because it's uncomfortable to me, but this one is a peel mask and much better in my opinion. The smell is not my favorite, but I quickly got over it once I saw how wonderful my skin looked after peeling it off.
